accepted.title: Ετήσια Έκθεση 2024 - Συνήγορος του Καταναλωτή

accepted.population: Complaints (αναφορές) submitted by consumers to the Consumer Ombudsman in 2024 (and to ECC Greece for the combined total)
accepted.sample: administrative data (18,192 complaints to the Ombudsman in 2024; 19,061 including ECC Greece)
accepted.licence: All rights reserved (site footer); no reuse licence stated
accepted.supports: Greek complaint landscape by sector and complaint type, including consumer-goods sub-sectors ICT goods, large household appliances and non-ICT/entertainment electronics, complaint content such as delivery of goods (non- or partial delivery, delay, customer service), product quality, sales method (e-commerce vs face to face) and mediation outcomes; also case examples on courier/postal non-delivery and damaged parcels.
